name: Cipher visual check

# Renders the showcase at a baseline ref and a candidate ref, pixel-diffs every snapshot and uploads the
# changed images with a summary. Scoped mode renders only the showcase pages whose examples reach a
# changed source file, and falls back to every page for tokens, global CSS and frame or overlay primitives.
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/cipher-visual.yml
      - ci/visual/**
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      base:
        description: Baseline ref (tag, branch or sha). Defaults to the newest release tag.
      candidate:
        description: Candidate ref
        default: main
      scope:
        description: full or scoped
        type: choice
        options: [full, scoped]
        default: full

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  # Any changed pixel counts, antialiasing included. Renders are byte-identical run to run, so a zero
  # threshold adds no noise and catches low-contrast fills that pixelmatch's default would miss.
  PIXEL_THRESHOLD: "0"

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event.action != 'labeled' || github.event.label.name == 'cipher-visual:scoped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      base: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.base }}
      candidate: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.candidate }}
      pages: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.pages }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Scope
        id: scope
        env:
          BASE: ${{ inputs.base }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ inputs.candidate || 'main' }}
          MODE: ${{ inputs.scope || (contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'cipher-visual:scoped') && 'scoped' || 'full') }}
        run: |
          git fetch -q --tags origin main
          [ -n "$BASE" ] || BASE=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -1)
          resolve() { git rev-parse -q --verify "origin/$1^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse "$1^{commit}"; }
          base=$(resolve "$BASE")
          candidate=$(resolve "$CANDIDATE")
          node ci/visual/scope.mjs --cipher . --base "$base" --candidate "$candidate" > /tmp/refs.json
          source=$(jq -r .candidate.source /tmp/refs.json)
          git worktree add -q --detach /tmp/cand "$source"
          node -e '
            const fs = require("fs");
            const catalog = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("/tmp/cand/site/src/catalog.json", "utf8"));
            fs.writeFileSync("/tmp/pages.json", JSON.stringify({
              alias: { "@infisical/cipher/": "/tmp/cand/src/" },
              pages: catalog.map((e) => ({ id: e.id, entries: e.examples.map((x) => "/tmp/cand/site/src/examples/" + x.module + ".tsx") }))
            }));'
          node ci/visual/scope.mjs --cipher /tmp/cand --base "$base" --candidate "$source" --pages /tmp/pages.json --showcase \
            | jq --arg mode "$MODE" --arg b "$BASE" --arg c "$CANDIDATE" '.mode = $mode | .base.ref = $b | .candidate.ref = $c' > scope.json
          pages=""
          if [ "$MODE" = scoped ] && [ "$(jq .full scope.json)" = false ]; then
            pages=$(jq -r '[.pages[].id] | join(",")' scope.json)
            [ -n "$pages" ] || pages="none"
          fi
          echo "base=$(jq -r .base.source scope.json)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "candidate=$source" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "pages=$pages" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          jq -c '{mode, full, fullReasons, changed, icons, pages: (.pages | length)}' scope.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: cipher-visual-scope
          path: scope.json

  capture:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.pages != 'none'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble@sha256:9beb546099e11f52d62e505537914870e01a67e0e6b00ae41da4775324e73dbe
      options: --ipc=host
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        side: [base, candidate]
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    env:
      CI: "1"
      HOME: /root
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs[matrix.side] }}
          path: side
      - uses: actions/cache@0057852bfaa89a56745cba8c7296529d2fc39830 # v4.3.0
        with:
          path: /root/.npm
          key: npm2-${{ hashFiles('package-lock.json', 'side/package-lock.json') }}
          restore-keys: npm2-
      - name: Install
        run: |
          npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
          cd side && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline
      - name: Build
        run: |
          for file in site/visual.html site/src/visual.tsx site/vite.visual.config.ts; do cp "$file" "side/$file"; done
          cd side && npx vite build --config site/vite.visual.config.ts --logLevel error
      - name: Capture
        env:
          VISUAL_PAGES: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.pages }}
          VISUAL_CATALOG: ${{ github.workspace }}/side/site/src/catalog.json
          VISUAL_SNAPSHOTS: ${{ github.workspace }}/snapshots
          VISUAL_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4173/
        run: |
          [ -n "$VISUAL_PAGES" ] || unset VISUAL_PAGES
          (cd side && npx vite preview --config site/vite.visual.config.ts --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4173 --strictPort > /tmp/preview.log 2>&1 &)
          for _ in $(seq 60); do curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:4173/visual.html > /dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
          npx playwright test visual/visual.spec.ts --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/8 --update-snapshots=all --pass-with-no-tests --reporter=dot
          echo "$(find snapshots -name '*.png' | wc -l) snapshots"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: snapshots-${{ matrix.side }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: snapshots
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          retention-days: 7

  diff:
    needs: [prepare, capture]
    if: always() && needs.prepare.result == 'success' && (needs.capture.result == 'success' || needs.capture.result == 'skipped')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          sparse-checkout: ci/visual
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: ci/visual/package-lock.json
      - if: needs.capture.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: snapshots-base-*
          path: before
          merge-multiple: true
      - if: needs.capture.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: snapshots-candidate-*
          path: after
          merge-multiple: true
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          name: cipher-visual-scope
      - name: Diff
        run: |
          npm ci --prefix ci/visual --no-audit --no-fund
          node ci/visual/compare.mjs before after report scope.json >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          cp scope.json report/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: cipher-visual-report
          path: report
          retention-days: 14

name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run check
      - run: npm run build
      - run: npm pack --dry-run
      - run: npm run site:build

name: Visual

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: visual-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  screenshots:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.65.0-noble
      options: --ipc=host
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    env:
      CI: "1"
      HOME: /root
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
      - run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - run: npx playwright test --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4
      - if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: visual-diffs-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: visual/results
          retention-days: 14

  baseline-label:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Baseline changes need the visual-change label
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          LABELED: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'visual-change') }}
        run: |
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$BASE"...HEAD -- visual/baselines | wc -l)
          if [ "$changed" -gt 0 ] && [ "$LABELED" != "true" ]; then
            echo "::error::This PR changes $changed baseline image(s). Review them, then add the visual-change label."
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "$changed baseline image(s) changed; label present: $LABELED"

name: Showcase

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: [Release]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ref:
        description: Commit to publish. Leave empty for the source of the newest release tag.
        required: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

concurrency:
  group: pages
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  build:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out the released source
        env:
          REF: ${{ inputs.ref }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$REF" ]; then
            git checkout "$REF"
          else
            tag=$(git tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -1)
            git checkout "$tag^"
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run site:build -- --base /cipher/
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1
        with:
          path: site/dist

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5

name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      commit:
        description: Full sha of the merged Release PR commit on main
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4.4.0
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.commit }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Release only a commit that is on main
        env:
          COMMIT: ${{ inputs.commit }}
          NPM_PUBLISH: ${{ vars.NPM_PUBLISH }}
        run: |
          if ! [[ "$COMMIT" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Pass the full 40-character sha, not a branch or a short sha."
            exit 1
          fi
          git fetch origin main
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$COMMIT" origin/main; then
            echo "$COMMIT is not on main. Merge the Release PR first, then dispatch with its commit."
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ "$NPM_PUBLISH" = "true" ] && [ "$COMMIT" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
            echo "npm provenance records the commit this run was dispatched from ($GITHUB_SHA), not $COMMIT. Dispatch from a branch or tag that points at $COMMIT, for example: git push origin $COMMIT:refs/heads/release-$COMMIT, then gh workflow run release.yml --ref release-$COMMIT -f commit=$COMMIT."
            exit 1
          fi
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          cache: npm
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm run check
      - run: npm run build
      - name: Tag a commit that holds the built package
        env:
          COMMIT: ${{ inputs.commit }}
          NPM_PUBLISH: ${{ vars.NPM_PUBLISH }}
        run: |
          version="$(node -p 'require("./package.json").version')"
          tag="v$version"
          npm pkg delete scripts devDependencies
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$tag"; then
            git fetch origin "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag"
            if [ "$NPM_PUBLISH" = "true" ] && [ "$(git rev-parse "$tag^")" = "$COMMIT" ] && ! npm view "@infisical/cipher@$version" version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "::notice::$tag already exists for this commit but isn't on npm, so this run only publishes it."
              git checkout -q -f "$tag"
              git clean -q -fdx dist
              exit 0
            fi
            echo "$tag already exists. Bump version in package.json first."
            exit 1
          fi
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add -f dist package.json
          git commit -m "Release $tag"
          git tag "$tag"
          git push origin "refs/tags/$tag"
      - name: Publish to npm
        if: vars.NPM_PUBLISH == 'true'
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: npm publish --provenance --access public
      - name: Skip npm until access is set up
        if: vars.NPM_PUBLISH != 'true'
        run: echo "::notice::Skipped npm publish. Set the NPM_PUBLISH repository variable to true once the npm package and its trusted publisher exist."
